books.title: 猜猜我有多爱你
books.reason_zh: 把爱说出口的经典范本，大小兔子用身边事物比爱，睡前亲子共读必收。
books.reason_en: The classic for saying 'I love you' in concrete ways; perfect bedtime bonding read.

books.title: 爷爷变成了幽灵
books.reason_zh: 把死亡讲得温柔又幽默，祖孙情动人，孩子生命教育绕不开的经典。
books.reason_en: Gently and humorously opens the door to death and remembrance; essential life education.

books.title: 狐狸的窗户
books.reason_zh: 安房直子唯美童话，桔梗花汁搭出魔法小窗，意境忧伤诗意，大童文学启蒙佳作。
books.reason_en: Awa's poetic fairy tale of a magic window and longing; a beautiful literary read for older kids.

books.title: 后来呢后来怎么了
books.reason_zh: 用天马行空的想象聊死亡与天堂，轻松不沉重，孩子笑着学会直面生命课题。
books.reason_en: Death imagined with wild humor and warmth; kids learn to face big questions with a smile.

books.title: 你看起来好像很好吃
books.reason_zh: 凶猛霸王龙被小甲龙叫爸爸，反差萌催泪又温暖，宫西达也爱与善良代表作。
books.reason_en: A fierce T. rex becomes a dad; tear-jerking and warm, Miyajima's signature tale of love.

books.title: 活了100万次的猫
books.reason_zh: 死了100万次的猫第一次为自己流泪，爱与生命的哲学寓言，常读常新。
books.reason_en: A cat that died a million times finally learns to love; a fable that stays with you.

books.title: 抵岸
books.reason_zh: 无字图像小说，电影般画面讲述移民的艰辛与希望，大童审美与共情进阶之选。
books.reason_en: Wordless graphic novel of migration and hope; cinematic art for mature young readers.

books.title: 不一样的卡梅拉（1-10册）
books.reason_zh: 敢想敢做的母鸡一家笑点密集，从共读到自读的桥梁书，法式幽默启蒙首选。
books.reason_en: A bold little hen's funny adventures; ideal bridge books from read-aloud to solo reading.

books.title: 海底的秘密
books.reason_zh: 一台神奇相机串起海底奇观，无字书大师的想象力盛宴，细节百看不厌。
books.reason_en: Wiesner's wordless fantasy of a magical undersea camera; endless details to pore over.

books.title: 四季时光
books.reason_zh: 无字情境认知书天花板，一座小镇四季流转，每页都能编出新故事，超耐读。
books.reason_en: Wordless seasonal town where every page births a new story; endlessly re-readable.

books.title: 永远永远爱你
books.reason_zh: 慈母龙妈妈养育霸王龙宝宝，讲透爱无关血缘，亲情主题催泪经典。
books.reason_en: A mother dinosaur raises a T. rex; love beyond blood, deeply moving.

books.title: 月亮忘记了
books.reason_zh: 坠落的月亮与孤独男孩互相陪伴，几米诗意治愈，适合大童读出温柔与勇气。
books.reason_en: Ji Mi's poetic tale of a lonely boy and the fallen moon; gentle comfort for growing hearts.

books.title: 小熊宝宝绘本（全15册）
books.reason_zh: 低幼生活习惯启蒙鼻祖，吃饭刷牙问好全覆盖，圆滚滚画风宝宝一看就爱。
books.reason_en: Toddler classic covering meals, brushing and greetings; adorable and gentle.

books.title: 时光电影院
books.reason_zh: 用一场场电影串起对妈妈的思念与成长，几米治愈长篇，共读有泪点。
books.reason_en: Movies weave a girl's longing for her lost mother; a moving Ji Mi growth story.

books.title: 妈妈，买绿豆！
books.reason_zh: 买绿豆煮绿豆种绿豆，平凡日常写出最浓母子情，生活气息满分的经典。
books.reason_en: Buying, cooking and planting mung beans; everyday warmth between mother and son.

books.title: 这是苹果吗也许是吧
books.reason_zh: 一个苹果引出上百种可能，脑洞与哲思兼备，点燃孩子发散思维的想象力神书。
books.reason_en: One apple sparks a hundred possibilities; a wonder-machine for divergent thinking.

books.title: 星空
books.reason_zh: 两个孤独少年逃离城市共赏星空，几米成长治愈代表作，适合小学高年级。
books.reason_en: Two lonely teens find healing under the stars; Ji Mi's coming-of-age classic.

books.title: 失落的一角遇见大圆满
books.reason_zh: 极简线条寓言讲成熟与依赖，大人孩子各有读法，谢尔经典的人生启蒙课。
books.reason_en: A minimalist fable on maturity and independence; new meaning at every age.

books.title: 田鼠阿佛
books.reason_zh: 收集阳光颜色和词语的小田鼠，肯定精神生活的价值，李欧·李奥尼哲学绘本。
books.reason_en: The mouse who gathers sunshine and words; celebrates imagination and self-worth.

books.title: 爱心树
books.reason_zh: 一棵有求必应的树陪男孩一生，付出与索取的经典寓言，亲子谈爱的入口。
books.reason_en: A giving tree and a boy across a lifetime; the classic parable of love and giving.

books.title: 爷爷一定有办法
books.reason_zh: 旧毯子变外套背心领带，重复节奏朗朗上口，画面里老鼠一家藏双线彩蛋。
books.reason_en: Grandpa turns a blanket into treasures; rhythmic text plus a hidden mouse subplot.

books.title: 奥菲利娅的影子剧院
books.reason_zh: 平凡老姑娘收留影子办剧院，米切尔·恩德诗意哲理，教孩子优雅面对孤独与死亡。
books.reason_en: A humble woman shelters shadows and finds light; Ende's poetic wisdom on loss.

books.title: 花婆婆
books.reason_zh: 「做一件让世界更美的事」，花婆婆一生践行的浪漫约定，价值观启蒙必收。
books.reason_en: 'Do something to make the world more beautiful'; a lifelong promise kept.

books.title: 我的爸爸叫焦尼
books.reason_zh: 单亲孩子与爸爸相聚的一天，不卖惨只讲爱，离异家庭孩子的温柔安慰。
books.reason_en: A boy's precious day with his dad; tender comfort for children of split families.

books.title: 晚安，大猩猩
books.reason_zh: 调皮大猩猩偷钥匙放出全动物园，几乎无字却笑点满满，睡前共读神器。
books.reason_en: A gorilla's near-wordless zoo breakout; pure bedtime comedy gold.

books.title: 夏天守则
books.reason_zh: 哥哥的奇怪规则与弟弟的挫败爆发，超现实画面讲透手足关系，话题感十足。
books.reason_en: Weird brotherly rules and a little brother's breaking point; surreal sibling insight.

books.title: 不可思议的旅程
books.reason_zh: 红笔画什么成什么，无字冒险如电影般流畅，想象力与观察力双练，三部曲开篇。
books.reason_en: A magic red pen opens a wordless cinematic quest; fuels imagination and focus.

books.title: 7号梦工厂
books.reason_zh: 小男孩闯入云端梦工厂管起不听话的云，无字书想象力狂欢，百看不厌。
books.reason_en: A boy runs the cloud factory in the sky; Wiesner's wordless wonder.

books.title: 坏狐狸
books.reason_zh: 装凶失败的狐狸孵蛋当了鸡妈妈，法式冷幽默加反差萌，同名动画电影也好看。
books.reason_en: A fox who fails at being fierce raises chicks; French deadpan humor, pure charm.

books.title: 铁丝网上的小花
books.reason_zh: 二战题材经典，女孩视角见证集中营悲剧，灰冷画面震撼，和平与良知教育必读。
books.reason_en: A girl's quiet witness to WWII horror; powerful peace and conscience education.

books.title: 点点点
books.reason_zh: 按一按摇一摇点点就变魔术，互动性拉满的魔法书，把娃从屏幕前拉回书前。
books.reason_en: Press, shake and the dots work magic; irresistible interactive fun, screen-free.

books.title: 小兔彼得和他的朋友们（全3册）
books.reason_zh: 波特小姐23篇田园童话全收录，小兔彼得百年经典，文学美育双重滋养。
books.reason_en: Beatrix Potter's complete pastoral tales; a century of literary and visual nourishment.

books.title: 好饿的毛毛虫
books.reason_zh: 洞洞书加变蝴蝶，数数认星期认食物全囊括，低幼认知启蒙第一书。
books.reason_en: Die-cut pages and metamorphosis; counting, weekdays and food in one classic.

books.title: 松鼠先生和月亮
books.reason_zh: 「月亮」掉进屋里原来是块奶酪，荒诞误会喜剧，钢笔线描画风笑点密集。
books.reason_en: The 'fallen moon' is just cheese; an absurd, hilarious misunderstanding comedy.

books.title: 白兔夫人
books.reason_zh: 爱丽丝白兔家的番外日常，精致画面埋满幽默细节，读爱丽丝后更有味。
books.reason_en: The White Rabbit family's witty home life; richer fun after reading Alice.

books.title: 朱家故事
books.reason_zh: 妈妈罢工后父子变猪的超现实讽喻，轻松聊家务分工与家庭平等，安东尼·布朗代表作。
books.reason_en: When Mom leaves, dad and sons turn into pigs; witty lesson on sharing housework.

books.title: 小房子
books.reason_zh: 小房子看乡村变城市又回归自然，城市化议题诗意图景，凯迪克金奖经典。
books.reason_en: A house watches the countryside become city; poetic Caldecott classic on change.

books.title: 逃家小兔
books.reason_zh: 妈妈永远追得上逃跑的小兔，爱的捉迷藏流行一甲子，低幼安全感奠基之作。
books.reason_en: Every runaway bunny is found; the original game of love, sixty years strong.

books.title: 桃花源的故事
books.reason_zh: 陶渊明《桃花源记》绘本版，蔡皋画风古朴动人，古典文学启蒙（建议增设人文主题）。
books.reason_en: Tao Yuanming's Peach Blossom Spring in pictures; gateway to Chinese classics (suggest humanities theme).

books.title: 蓝莲花
books.reason_zh: 丁丁远赴中国历险结识挚友张，经典冒险漫画（章节式桥梁书），适合大童自主阅读。
books.reason_en: Tintin's China adventure with his lifelong friend Chang; classic comic for independent readers.

books.title: 野兽国
books.reason_zh: 撒野男孩在野兽国称王又想回家，直面孩子怒气的凯迪克金奖，情绪教育鼻祖。
books.reason_en: A wild boy kings the beasts and sails home; Caldecott gold on handling anger.

books.title: 雪人
books.reason_zh: 全无字却温暖满格，男孩与雪人的奇妙一夜，搭配同名动画更佳。
books.reason_en: Wordless winter magic between a boy and his snowman; pair with the beloved film.

books.title: 爱德华的奇妙之旅
books.reason_zh: 瓷兔子学会爱与被爱的旅程，纽伯瑞银奖章节书，适合大童自主阅读。
books.reason_en: A china rabbit learns to love; Newbery Honor chapter book for solo readers.

books.title: 小金鱼逃走了
books.reason_zh: 在窗帘糖果罐里找小金鱼，专注力观察力训练鼻祖，低幼游戏书天花板。
books.reason_en: Hunt the runaway goldfish through every page; the original toddler seek-and-find.

books.title: 当鸭子遇见死神
books.reason_zh: 死神温柔陪伴鸭子走完最后旅程，哲思版生命教育，安徒生奖作者之作。
books.reason_en: Death gently walks with a duck; a philosophical, tender classic on mortality.

books.title: 小狐狸买手套
books.reason_zh: 狐狸妈妈放手让小狐狸独自进城，温柔讲信任与善意，入选小学语文课本。
books.reason_en: A mother fox lets her kit brave town alone; tender trust and kindness, textbook favorite.

books.title: 鳄鱼怕怕牙医怕怕
books.reason_zh: 病人牙医互相害怕的双视角神作，幽默化解看牙恐惧，刷牙教育必收。
books.reason_en: Scared patient, scared dentist; humor melts dentist fear and builds brushing habits.

books.title: 肚子里有个火车站
books.reason_zh: 把消化系统画成肚子火车站，吃太快小精灵会罢工，饮食习惯科普神书。
books.reason_en: Digestion as a busy train station in your belly; science that fixes eating habits.

books.title: 不可思议的朋友
books.reason_zh: 真实故事改编，与自闭症男孩二十年的友谊，同理心与包容教育首选绘本。
books.reason_en: A true-story friendship with an autistic boy spanning twenty years; empathy at its best.

books.title: 小蓝和小黄
books.reason_zh: 小蓝小黄抱在一起变绿，用色块讲友谊与自我，李欧·李奥尼天才成名作。
books.reason_en: Little Blue hugs Little Yellow and turns green; Lionni's genius debut on friendship.

books.title: 大猩猩
books.reason_zh: 冷冰冰的爸爸和有魔法的大猩猩，超现实讲孩子对陪伴的渴望，安东尼·布朗经典。
books.reason_en: A magical gorilla answers a lonely girl's wish for dad; Browne's classic on companionship.

books.title: 你好灯塔
books.reason_zh: 守塔人一家与世隔绝的坚守，凯迪克金奖，细腻画面讲责任与爱。
books.reason_en: A lighthouse keeper family's devoted life; Caldecott Medal art of duty and love.

books.title: 糖球
books.reason_zh: 吃下糖球能听见他人心声，从孤单到主动交朋友，白希那共情治愈神作。
books.reason_en: Magic candies let a boy hear others' hearts; Baek Heena's empathy-filled healing tale.
